title: A directed limit of nonempty quasi-compact schemes with affine transition morphisms is nonempty
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ ($i\ge i'$) an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $(S,(f_i)_{i\in I})$, $f_i:S\to S_i$, be a limit of this system in the category of schemes [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. If every $S_i$ is nonempty and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], then $S$ is nonempty (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01Z2).

mathlib_searches.query: limit of a cofiltered diagram of nonempty quasi-compact schemes with affine transition maps is nonempty

mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.nonempty_of_isLimit (Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineTransitionLimit): [IsCofilteredOrEmpty I] [∀ f, IsAffineHom (D.map f)] [∀ i, Nonempty (D.obj i)] [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] : Nonempty c.pt

mathlib_searches.query: inverse limit of nonempty quasi-compact schemes along affine morphisms is nonempty

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: an inverse system over the directed set I is a functor D from the category of I (with the opposite order), which is cofiltered, hence IsCofilteredOrEmpty; the transition morphisms are IsAffineHom (Mathlib's affine morphisms, pqf-def-affine-morphism); a scheme is quasi-compact iff its underlying space is CompactSpace; (S,(f_i)) is a limit cone c with hc : IsLimit c; the conclusion Nonempty c.pt is that S is nonempty.
